```{r volcano, fig.width = 6.7, fig.height = 4}
# Not in the tutorial; standard companion to the MA plot. Genes of the candidate pathways are
# coloured by pathway (first match if a gene is in several; OXPHOS = nuclear-encoded); candidate
# genes (CANDIDATE GENES) are marked by tier; the top 3 per pathway by p value, any
# padj < PADJ_CUT gene and every Tier 1 / Tier 2 candidate gene are labelled.
plot_volcano <- function(de, tissue) {
  df <- de |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj)) |>
    left_join(cand_member, by = "ensemblID") |>
    mutate(pathway = factor(replace_na(pathway, "Other"), levels = c(names(CANDIDATE_TERMS), "Other")),
           sig = padj < PADJ_CUT)
  tiers <- dplyr::filter(cand_genes, tissue == !!tissue)
  df  <- df |> left_join(dplyr::select(tiers, ensemblID, tier), by = "ensemblID")
  lab <- bind_rows(df |> dplyr::filter(pathway != "Other") |> group_by(pathway) |>
                     slice_min(pvalue, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) |> ungroup(),
                   dplyr::filter(df, sig | !is.na(tier))) |> dplyr::distinct(ensemblID, .keep_all = TRUE)
  ggplot(df, aes(log2FoldChange_shrunk, -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(df, pathway == "Other"), colour = "grey80", size = 0.4, stroke = 0) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(df, pathway != "Other"), aes(colour = pathway), size = 0.7,
               alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(df, sig), shape = 21, colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1.2, stroke = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(df, !is.na(tier)), aes(shape = tier), colour = "black", size = 1.4,
               stroke = 0.3) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`Tier 1` = 5, `Tier 2` = 4), name = NULL) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(PADJ_CUT), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = Symbol, colour = pathway), size = pt(6), show.legend = FALSE,
                    segment.size = 0.2, max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(CANDIDATE_COLS, Other = "black"), drop = FALSE,
                        breaks = names(CANDIDATE_TERMS)) +
    labs(title = tissue, x = "Shrunken log2 fold change (Cre / GFP)", y = "-log10 FDR", colour = NULL) +
    theme_bulk() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(size = 1.5)))
}
p_volc <- map2(fits$de, fits$tissue, plot_volcano) |> wrap_plots(nrow = 1, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_plot(p_volc, file.path(FIG_DIR, "deseq2", "volcano_cre_vs_gfp"), "full", 100)

# DEG volcano for the 2025-10-run test (Cre vs switch GFP; CANDIDATE GENES), where the DEGs are:
# unshrunk log2FC, padj < PADJ_CUT genes filled by direction, candidate-pathway genes coloured,
# every DEG labelled.
plot_volcano_oct <- function(tissue) {
  df  <- dplyr::filter(cand_genes_all, tissue == !!tissue, !is.na(padj_oct)) |>
    mutate(pathway = factor(replace_na(pathway, "Other"), levels = c(names(CANDIDATE_TERMS), "Other")),
           direction = case_when(padj_oct < PADJ_CUT & log2FC_oct > 0 ~ "Up in Cre",
                                 padj_oct < PADJ_CUT & log2FC_oct < 0 ~ "Down in Cre", TRUE ~ "NS"))
  lab <- dplyr::filter(df, direction != "NS")
  ggplot(df, aes(log2FC_oct, -log10(padj_oct))) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(df, pathway == "Other", direction == "NS"), colour = "grey80",
               size = 0.4, stroke = 0) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(df, pathway != "Other", direction == "NS"), aes(colour = pathway),
               size = 0.6, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0) +
    geom_point(data = lab, aes(fill = direction), shape = 21, colour = "black", size = 1.4, stroke = 0.25) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(PADJ_CUT), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = Symbol), size = pt(6), colour = "black",
                    segment.size = 0.2, max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = CANDIDATE_COLS, name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`Up in Cre` = GROUP_COLS[["Cre"]], `Down in Cre` = GROUP_COLS[["GFP"]]),
                      name = NULL) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s · 2025-10 run: Cre vs switch GFP (%d DEGs)", tissue, nrow(lab)),
         x = "log2 fold change (Cre / GFP)", y = "-log10 FDR") +
    theme_bulk() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(size = 1.5)))
}
```

```{r sample-heatmaps}
# Tutorial: rlog -> sample distance + Pearson correlation heatmaps. All AAV samples of the
# tissue, with the bridge-estimated run offset applied to the 2025-04 samples (the same
# normalization factors the primary test uses), so the 2025-10 GFP check samples should sit
# among the 2025-04 GFP if the correction worked.
anno_cols <- list(cmp_group = CMP_COLS, sex = c(Female = "grey30", Male = "grey80"))

sample_heatmaps <- function(fit, tissue) {
  rld  <- rlog(fit$dds_display, blind = TRUE)
  ann  <- as.data.frame(colData(rld))[, c("cmp_group", "sex")]
  d    <- dist(t(assay(rld)))
  dmat <- as.matrix(d)
  common <- list(annotation_col = ann, annotation_colors = anno_cols, fontsize = 6,
                 fontfamily = FONT, border_color = NA, treeheight_row = 10,
                 treeheight_col = 10, silent = TRUE)
  ph_dist <- do.call(pheatmap, c(list(dmat, clustering_distance_rows = d,
                                      clustering_distance_cols = d,
                                      color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues")))(255),
                                      main = tissue), common))
  ph_cor  <- do.call(pheatmap, c(list(cor(assay(rld), method = "pearson"), main = tissue), common))
  save_pheatmap(ph_dist, file.path(FIG_DIR, "qc", sprintf("distance_sample_heatmap_%s", tolower(tissue))))
  save_pheatmap(ph_cor,  file.path(FIG_DIR, "qc", sprintf("similarity_sample_heatmap_%s", tolower(tissue))))
  list(rld = rld, dist = ph_dist, cor = ph_cor)
}

rlds <- map2(fits$fit, fits$tissue, sample_heatmaps) |> set_names(fits$tissue)
walk(rlds, \(x) { grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(x$dist$gtable) })
```

```{r sig-gene-heatmap}
# Tutorial: heatmap of significant genes (rlog): the top 50 genes by padj among
# padj < PADJ_CUT (0.05), row-scaled.
sig_heatmap <- function(rld, de, tissue, n = 50) {
  top <- de |> dplyr::filter(padj < PADJ_CUT) |> slice_min(padj, n = n, with_ties = FALSE)
  if (nrow(top) < 2) return(NULL)
  mat <- assay(rld)[top$ensemblID, ]
  rownames(mat) <- top$Symbol
  ann <- as.data.frame(colData(rld))[, c("cmp_group", "sex")]
  ord <- order(ann$cmp_group, ann$sex)
  ph <- pheatmap(mat[, ord], scale = "row", cluster_cols = FALSE, annotation_col = ann[ord, ],
                 annotation_colors = anno_cols,
                 gaps_col = cumsum(table(ann$cmp_group))[-nlevels(ann$cmp_group)],
                 color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(101),
                 breaks = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 102), fontsize = 6, fontfamily = FONT,
                 border_color = NA, treeheight_row = 10, main = tissue, silent = TRUE)
  save_pheatmap(ph, file.path(FIG_DIR, "deseq2", sprintf("sig_gene_heatmap_%s", tolower(tissue))),
                "single", max(60, 2.6 * nrow(top) + 30))
  ph
}
sig_hms <- pmap(list(map(rlds, "rld"), fits$de, fits$tissue), sig_heatmap) |> compact()
walk(sig_hms, \(ph) { grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(ph$gtable) })
```

###PATHWAY ANALYSIS (tutorial: DE Pathway Analysis, clusterProfiler)###

Following the tutorial: Ensembl → Entrez with `mapIds(multiVals = "first")`, retrying unmapped genes by symbol, dropping duplicate Entrez IDs, and ranking genes by log2 fold change for `gseGO`. Two deliberate changes from the tutorial code:

- the GSEA ranking uses **every tested gene** (the tutorial ranks only the significant genes, which leaves GSEA nothing to compare against), ranked by the **apeglm-shrunken** log2FC so noisy low-count genes don't dominate the extremes;
- custom contigs (hAPOE, transgenes) are removed, as the tutorial removes ERCC spike-ins.

```{r pathway-ids}
# Clear this section's previous outputs so a result that is empty this run cannot leave an
# older file behind (these folders hold only files written by the pathway chunks).
walk(file.path(c(CSV_DIR, FIG_DIR), "pathway"),
     \(d) unlink(list.files(d, full.names = TRUE)))

map_entrez <- function(de) {
  d <- de |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), str_starts(ensemblID, "ENSMUSG")) |>
    mutate(entrez = mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = ensemblID, column = "ENTREZID",
                           keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"))
  miss <- is.na(d$entrez) & !is.na(d$Symbol) & d$Symbol %in% keys(org.Mm.eg.db, "SYMBOL")
  if (any(miss))
    d$entrez[miss] <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = d$Symbol[miss], column = "ENTREZID",
                             keytype = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")
  d |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(entrez)) |> dplyr::distinct(entrez, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

ranked_genes <- function(d) sort(set_names(d$log2FoldChange_shrunk, d$entrez), decreasing = TRUE)

paths <- fits |>
  transmute(tissue, mapped = map(de, map_entrez), ranked = map(mapped, ranked_genes))
paths |> transmute(tissue, n_mapped = map_int(mapped, nrow))
```

```{r pathway-gsea}
# gseGO for each GO ontology (tutorial ran CC; BP and MF added)
run_gsego <- function(ranked, ont)
  gseGO(geneList = ranked, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, ont = ont, keyType = "ENTREZID",
        minGSSize = 15, maxGSSize = 500, pvalueCutoff = PADJ_CUT, eps = 0,
        seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE) |>
  setReadable(OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")

gsea <- expand_grid(tissue = TISSUES, ont = c("BP", "MF", "CC")) |>
  left_join(dplyr::select(paths, tissue, ranked), by = "tissue") |>
  mutate(res = map2(ranked, ont, run_gsego),
         n_sig = map_int(res, \(r) nrow(as.data.frame(r))))
saveRDS(dplyr::select(gsea, -ranked), file.path(OBJ_DIR, "gseGO_cre_vs_gfp.rds"))
dplyr::select(gsea, tissue, ont, n_sig)

gsea |>
  dplyr::filter(n_sig > 0) |>
  pwalk(\(tissue, ont, ranked, res, n_sig)
        write_tsv(as.data.frame(res),
                  file.path(CSV_DIR, "pathway", sprintf("%s_gseGO_%s.tsv", tolower(tissue), ont))))
```

```{r pathway-gsea-loo}
# Robustness of each primary GSEA term:
#  - leave-one-out: GSEA rerun on the primary model refit without each 2025-10 GFP mouse
#    (fits$fit[[.]]$loo); must stay significant, same NES sign;
#  - within-run direction: GSEA on the 2025-10-only Cre vs GFP fold changes; NES must have the
#    same sign (direction only; that comparison has 3 GFP).
# gseGO is run with every term returned (pvalueCutoff = 1) so missing terms are real misses.
gsea_all <- function(lfc_tbl, ont)
  gseGO(geneList = ranked_genes(map_entrez(lfc_tbl)), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, ont = ont,
        keyType = "ENTREZID", minGSSize = 15, maxGSSize = 500, pvalueCutoff = 1, eps = 0,
        seed = TRUE, verbose = FALSE) |>
  as.data.frame()

lfc_table <- function(res, lfc)
  as_tibble(as.data.frame(res), rownames = "ensemblID") |>
  mutate(log2FoldChange_shrunk = lfc) |>
  left_join(dplyr::select(id2name, ensemblID, Symbol), by = "ensemblID")

fit_of <- set_names(fits$fit, fits$tissue)

gsea_loo <- gsea |>
  dplyr::filter(n_sig > 0) |>
  dplyr::select(tissue, ont, res) |>
  mutate(loo = map2(tissue, ont, \(t, o)
           imap(fit_of[[t]]$loo, \(l, b) gsea_all(lfc_table(l$res, l$lfc), o) |>
                  transmute(ID, NES_loo = NES, padj_loo = p.adjust, dropped = b)) |>
             bind_rows() |> (\(x) if (nrow(x)) x else
               tibble(ID = character(), NES_loo = double(), padj_loo = double(), dropped = character()))()),
         within = map2(tissue, ont, \(t, o) {
           w <- fit_of[[t]]$within
           gsea_all(lfc_table(w, w$log2FoldChange), o) |> transmute(ID, NES_within = NES)
         }),
  robust = pmap(list(res, loo, within), \(r, l, w) {
    n_fits <- n_distinct(l$dropped)
    as.data.frame(r) |>
      dplyr::select(ID, Description, NES, p.adjust) |>
      left_join(l, by = "ID") |>
      group_by(ID, Description, NES, p.adjust) |>
      summarise(n_loo = sum(!is.na(padj_loo)),
                loo_max_padj = suppressWarnings(max(padj_loo, na.rm = TRUE)),
                loo_same_sign = all(sign(NES_loo) == sign(NES[1]), na.rm = TRUE),
                drivers = paste(dropped[!is.na(dropped) & (is.na(padj_loo) | padj_loo >= PADJ_CUT |
                                          sign(NES_loo) != sign(NES[1]))], collapse = ";"),
                .groups = "drop") |>
      left_join(w, by = "ID") |>
      mutate(within_same_sign = sign(NES_within) == sign(NES),
             loo_ok = n_fits == 0 |
               (n_loo == n_fits & loo_same_sign & loo_max_padj < PADJ_CUT),
             robust = loo_ok & within_same_sign %in% TRUE) |>
      arrange(desc(robust), p.adjust)
  }))

pwalk(dplyr::select(gsea_loo, tissue, ont, robust), \(tissue, ont, robust)
      write_tsv(robust, file.path(CSV_DIR, "pathway",
                                  sprintf("%s_gseGO_%s_loo_robustness.tsv", tolower(tissue), ont))))
gsea_loo |> transmute(tissue, ont, n_terms = map_int(robust, nrow),
                      n_robust = map_int(robust, \(r) sum(r$robust)))
```

```{r pathway-gsea-plots, fig.width = 6.7, fig.height = 5}
# Tutorial plots: dotplot, ridgeplot, cnetplot, gseaplot of the top term
gsea_figs <- function(tissue, ont, ranked, res, n_sig) {
  stem <- file.path(FIG_DIR, "pathway", sprintf("%s_gseGO_%s", tolower(tissue), ont))
  ttl  <- sprintf("%s · GO %s", tissue, ont)
  dot <- dotplot(res, showCategory = 15, split = ".sign", font.size = 6, label_format = 45) +
    facet_grid(~ .sign) + labs(title = ttl) + theme_bulk() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
  ridge <- ridgeplot(res, showCategory = 15, label_format = 45) +
    labs(title = ttl, x = "Shrunken log2FC") + theme_bulk() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
  cnet <- cnetplot(res, foldChange = ranked, showCategory = 5) +
    labs(title = ttl) +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 6, family = FONT),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"))
  # gseaplot2 draws tick labels at 0.8 x base_size; 8 keeps them >= 6 pt
  curve <- gseaplot2(res, geneSetID = 1, title = res$Description[1], base_size = 8,
                     subplots = 1:2, rel_heights = c(1.5, 0.4))
  save_plot(dot,   paste0(stem, "_dotplot"),   "full", 110)
  save_plot(ridge, paste0(stem, "_ridgeplot"), "onehalf", 110)
  save_plot(cnet,  paste0(stem, "_cnetplot"),  "full", 130)
  save_plot(curve, paste0(stem, "_top_term_gseaplot"), "onehalf", 80)
  # enrichment curves for the candidate pathways that are significant here (e.g. OXPHOS)
  cand_ids <- intersect(unname(CANDIDATE_TERMS), res$ID)
  if (length(cand_ids)) {
    cc <- gseaplot2(res, geneSetID = cand_ids, base_size = 8, subplots = 1:2,
                    rel_heights = c(1.5, 0.4), title = sprintf("%s · candidate pathways", tissue))
    save_plot(cc, paste0(stem, "_candidate_gseaplot"), "onehalf", 90)
  }
  list(dot = dot, ridge = ridge)
}

# figures show every significant term (padj < PADJ_CUT); the leave-one-out robustness of each
# term is in csv/pathway/*_loo_robustness.tsv
gsea_plots <- gsea |>
  dplyr::filter(n_sig > 0) |>
  dplyr::select(tissue, ont, res, n_sig) |>
  left_join(dplyr::select(paths, tissue, ranked), by = "tissue") |>
  dplyr::select(tissue, ont, ranked, res, n_sig) |>
  pmap(gsea_figs)
walk(gsea_plots, \(x) print(x$dot))
```

```{r pathway-ora}
# ORA of the significant genes: GO BP (enrichGO) and KEGG (enrichKEGG, as in the tutorial),
# split by direction, universe = every tested gene with an Entrez ID.
run_ora <- function(mapped) {
  sig  <- dplyr::filter(mapped, padj < PADJ_CUT)
  sets <- split(sig$entrez, if_else(sig$log2FoldChange > 0, "Up in Cre", "Down in Cre"))
  if (length(sets) == 0) return(list(go = NULL, kegg = NULL))
  go <- compareCluster(sets, fun = "enrichGO", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID",
                       ont = "BP", universe = mapped$entrez, pvalueCutoff = PADJ_CUT,
                       qvalueCutoff = 1,     # padj < PADJ_CUT is the only significance rule
                       readable = TRUE)
  # KEGG is queried live from kegg.jp; skipped (NULL) if offline
  kegg <- tryCatch(compareCluster(sets, fun = "enrichKEGG", organism = "mmu",
                                  universe = mapped$entrez, pvalueCutoff = PADJ_CUT,
                                  qvalueCutoff = 1),
                   error = \(e) { message("KEGG unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  list(go = go, kegg = kegg)
}

ora <- paths |> transmute(tissue, ora = map(mapped, run_ora))
saveRDS(ora, file.path(OBJ_DIR, "ora_cre_vs_gfp.rds"))

ora_out <- ora |>
  mutate(go = map(ora, "go"), kegg = map(ora, "kegg")) |>
  dplyr::select(-ora) |>
  pivot_longer(c(go, kegg), names_to = "db", values_to = "res") |>
  dplyr::filter(!map_lgl(res, \(r) is.null(r) || nrow(as.data.frame(r)) == 0))

pwalk(ora_out, \(tissue, db, res) {
  stem <- file.path(sprintf("%s_ORA_%s", tolower(tissue), db))
  write_tsv(as.data.frame(res), file.path(CSV_DIR, "pathway", paste0(stem, ".tsv")))
  p <- dotplot(res, showCategory = 10, font.size = 6, label_format = 45) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s · %s", tissue, toupper(db)), x = NULL) + theme_bulk() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
  save_plot(p, file.path(FIG_DIR, "pathway", paste0(stem, "_dotplot")), "onehalf", 110)
  print(p)
})
```

###HEAD-TO-HEAD: PREVIOUS PIPELINE (DE analysis I, 2025-10-24)###

The earlier analysis (ljohnsonlab.github.io/4s2_liver, "Differential Expression Analysis I")
reproduced on this project's counts, then compared gene by gene with both its published tables
(saved in `objects/reference/previous_DE_analysis1/`) and with the analysis above.

Previous pipeline, as described on that page: nf-core/rnaseq (stock GRCm39, Ensembl 114, no
transgene / human APOE contigs); Batch 1 (2025-04 GFP) and Batch 2 (2025-10 Cre + GFP) analysed
together; technical replicates collapsed by averaging counts; genes kept with >= 20 counts in
>= 5 samples; DESeq2 `~ Sex + group`, **no batch term**; DEG = FDR < 0.01 and |log2FC| > 1;
"high-confidence" = DEGs after removing -ps / -rs pseudogenes, Gm / Rik / unannotated loci,
mt- and Rp genes. Reproduced here exactly, except the counts (STAR on the custom reference) and
the sample list as recorded at the time (B13 included, as it was then).

```{r previous-pipeline}
prev_dir <- file.path(IN_DIR, "reference", "previous_DE_analysis1")
prev <- map(set_names(c("liver_all", "liver_hc", "brain_all", "brain_hc")),
            \(x) read_tsv(file.path(prev_dir, sprintf("prev_%s.tsv", x)), show_col_types = FALSE))
meta_all <- read_csv(file.path(IN_DIR, "sample_metadata.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(sex = factor(sex), group = factor(group, levels = c("GFP Control", "Cre-AAV")))
hc_drop <- "-ps\\d*$|-rs\\d*$|^Gm\\d+|Rik\\d*$|^ENSMUS|^mt-|^Rp[ls]"
allCounts <- read_counts(COUNT_SOURCE)      # full matrix: B13 is part of the reproduction

prev_pipeline <- function(tissue) {
  m <- meta_all |> dplyr::filter(tissue == !!tissue, arm == "AAV")      # B13 included, as then
  # collapse technical replicates (same mouse in both runs) by averaging counts
  cts <- allCounts[setdiff(rownames(allCounts), CONSTRUCT_GENES), m$sample]
  by_mouse <- split(m$sample, m$mouse_id)
  cm <- sapply(by_mouse, \(s) round(rowMeans(cts[, s, drop = FALSE])))
  mm <- m |> dplyr::distinct(mouse_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |> column_to_rownames("mouse_id")
  mm <- mm[colnames(cm), ]
  cm <- cm[rowSums(cm >= 20) >= 5, ]                                    # >= 20 counts in >= 5 samples
  r <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(cm, mm, ~ sex + group) |> DESeq(quiet = TRUE) |>
    results(name = "group_Cre.AAV_vs_GFP.Control")
  tibble(ensemblID = rownames(r), baseMean = r$baseMean, log2FC = r$log2FoldChange, padj = r$padj) |>
    left_join(dplyr::select(id2name, ensemblID, Symbol), by = "ensemblID") |>
    mutate(Symbol = coalesce(Symbol, ensemblID),
           deg = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.01 & abs(log2FC) > 1,
           hc  = deg & !str_detect(Symbol, hc_drop))
}
repro <- map(set_names(TISSUES), prev_pipeline)

# same-mouse run difference (2025-10 minus 2025-04) from the double-run mice, for every gene:
# a "DEG" pointing the same way as this is what the run alone would produce
run_diff_tissue <- function(tissue) {
  m  <- meta_all |> dplyr::filter(tissue == !!tissue, arm == "AAV", sample != "B13")
  pr <- m |> group_by(mouse_id) |> dplyr::filter(n_distinct(run) == 2) |> ungroup()
  y  <- log2(t(t(allCounts[, pr$sample]) / estimateSizeFactorsForMatrix(allCounts[, pr$sample])) + 1)
  d  <- map(split(pr, pr$mouse_id), \(b) y[, b$sample[b$run == CRE_RUN]] - y[, b$sample[b$run == GFP_RUN]])
  tibble(ensemblID = rownames(y), run_diff = purrr::reduce(d, `+`) / length(d))
}

h2h_tissue <- function(tissue) {
  t  <- tolower(tissue)
  rp <- repro[[tissue]]
  cur_main <- fits$de[[match(tissue, fits$tissue)]] |> dplyr::select(ensemblID, padj_current = padj,
                                                                    log2FC_current = log2FoldChange_shrunk)
  cur_oct  <- cand_genes_all |> dplyr::filter(tissue == !!tissue) |>
    dplyr::select(ensemblID, log2FC_oct, padj_oct, tier)
  prev[[paste0(t, "_hc")]] |>
    dplyr::rename(Symbol = gene, log2FC_prev = log2FoldChange, padj_prev = padj) |>
    mutate(Symbol = if_else(Symbol == "APOE", "hAPOE", Symbol)) |>
    left_join(dplyr::select(rp, ensemblID, Symbol, log2FC_repro = log2FC, padj_repro = padj, deg_repro = deg) |>
                dplyr::distinct(Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE), by = "Symbol") |>
    left_join(run_diff_tissue(tissue), by = "ensemblID") |>
    left_join(cur_main, by = "ensemblID") |> left_join(cur_oct, by = "ensemblID") |>
    mutate(tissue = tissue,
           follows_run = sign(run_diff) == sign(log2FC_prev) & abs(run_diff) > 0.5,
           # all of these symbols exist in the annotation; they fail the >= 20-count filter here
           # because STAR GeneCounts / htseq count uniquely-mapped reads only, and their previous
           # "expression" was largely multi-mapped reads (retrogenes, multi-copy RNAs, paralogs)
           verdict = case_when(is.na(ensemblID) ~ "too few uniquely-mapped reads to test",
                               !is.na(tier) ~ paste("candidate here:", tier),
                               follows_run %in% TRUE ~ "run artifact (same-mouse run difference, same direction)",
                               TRUE ~ "not supported once run is controlled")) |>
    relocate(tissue, Symbol, verdict)
}
h2h <- map(TISSUES, h2h_tissue) |> bind_rows()
write_csv(h2h, file.path(CSV_DIR, "deseq2", "head_to_head_previous_hc_genes.csv"))

# summary: published vs reproduced vs current
h2h_summary <- map(TISSUES, \(tissue) {
  t <- tolower(tissue); rp <- repro[[tissue]]
  prev_all <- prev[[paste0(t, "_all")]]$gene; prev_hc <- prev[[paste0(t, "_hc")]]$gene
  tibble(tissue,
         published_DEGs = length(prev_all), reproduced_DEGs = sum(rp$deg),
         published_hc = length(prev_hc), reproduced_hc = sum(rp$hc),
         hc_overlap = length(intersect(prev_hc, rp$Symbol[rp$hc])),
         r_log2FC_published_vs_reproduced = {
           j <- inner_join(prev[[paste0(t, "_all")]], rp, by = c(gene = "Symbol"))
           cor(j$log2FoldChange, j$log2FC) },
         hc_following_run_pct = 100 * mean(dplyr::filter(h2h, tissue == !!tissue)$follows_run, na.rm = TRUE),
         current_main_DEGs = sum(fits$de[[match(tissue, fits$tissue)]]$padj < PADJ_CUT, na.rm = TRUE),
         current_2025_10_DEGs = sum(cand_genes_all$tissue == tissue & cand_genes_all$sig_oct))
}) |> bind_rows()
write_csv(h2h_summary, file.path(CSV_DIR, "deseq2", "head_to_head_summary.csv"))
h2h_summary
h2h |> dplyr::count(tissue, verdict)
h2h |> dplyr::filter(Symbol %in% c("hAPOE", "Eno1b", "Uba52rt", "Adrm1b", "Kpna2rt", "Ube2srt", "Hspb1")) |>
  dplyr::select(tissue, Symbol, verdict, log2FC_prev, log2FC_repro, run_diff, padj_current, padj_oct) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) signif(x, 2)))
```

```{r head-to-head-plot, fig.width = 6.7, fig.height = 3.2}
p_h2h <- h2h |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(run_diff)) |>
  ggplot(aes(run_diff, log2FC_prev, colour = verdict)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +

                  max.overlaps = Inf) +

                                 "candidate here: Tier 1" = "#1B7837", "candidate here: Tier 2" = "#5AAE61",
                                 "too few uniquely-mapped reads to test" = "grey80")) +
  labs(x = "Same-mouse run difference, log2 (2025-10 - 2025-04)",
       y = "Previous analysis log2FC (Cre / GFP)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bulk() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") + guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
save_plot(p_h2h, file.path(FIG_DIR, "deseq2", "head_to_head_previous_hc_genes"), "full", 95)
p_h2h
```
